title: Filming: Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono continued filming material for their feature film Imagine on 20 July 1971.

This was perhaps the best-known scene, which was used in the video of the song ‘Imagine’.

Lennon was filmed sitting at Ono’s white Steinway grand piano. He mimed to a recording of ‘Imagine’ while Ono opened the shutters of the windows, letting light into the room, before joining Lennon at the piano bench.

With the sequence complete, Lennon and Ono moved outside and were filmed running around the grounds of Tittenhurst Park. They pretended to be reunited after some time apart, and embraced after finding one another.
